definitions.ask: Should the builtin external_issue_mirror and external_pr_mirror jobs also skip the area-note repos?
definitions.why: They are builtin, not chezmoi-configured, and mirroring an empty tracker is cheap and harmless

choices.label: Leave the builtin mirror jobs alone; they keep polling the area-note repos every 15 minutes
Patch both builtin jobs on athena with the same allowlist; new code projects need adding too

definitions.ask: Should bbugyi200/tailnet also be dropped from refresh_docs?
definitions.why: tailnet has no area note, and its README and host notes are real docs worth refreshing

choices.label: Keep tailnet in the allowlist; it has no area note of its own and holds real host docs
Drop tailnet too, treating it as part of the dev area (dev.md lists it as a project alias)
